verses.1: Hallelujah! Hallelujah to the LORD from heaven! Hallelujah in all places!
verses.2: Hallelujah to him, all his creations! Hallelujah to him, all his armies!
verses.3: Hallelujah! The sun and the moon shall praise Him. All the stars shall sing His praises.
verses.4: Hallelujah, the names of the heavens and the waters that lie above the heavens!
verses.5: Let them praise the name of Jehovah, for He has commanded and they will be created.
verses.6: And He set them up forever, as a law given by Him; and they shall not be removed from their place.
verses.7: Hallelujah to Jehovah from the earth! Praise him, all the creatures of the land.
verses.8: Fire and snow, cold wind, and stormy clouds – they all do what they want.
verses.9: The mountains and all the trees that bear fruit, and all the olive trees.
verses.10: The living creatures and all animals are covered with scales and feathers.
verses.11: The kings of the earth and all the nations speak, and all the judges of the earth also speak.
verses.12: In the huts and also in the tents of the elderly people, along with the young boys.
verses.13: Let them praise the name of Jehovah, for His name alone is to be honored on earth and in heaven.
verses.14: And he raised a lamp for his people, a praise to all his believers among the children of Israel. With his closeness, he praised Yah.
